clues.text: This coaster reaches a top speed of 59 mph, stands 78 feet tall, and features zero inversions along its track.
Manufactured by Vekoma, this high-tech ride officially opened to park guests in 2016.
Riders must head to China to experience this futuristic Disney attraction.
This launched coaster is widely viewed as Shanghai Disneyland's replacement for Space Mountain, and its success led to a clone being built at the Magic Kingdom.
The attraction's name refers to an energetic sprint taken aboard the iconic, glowing two-wheeled vehicles from a Disney sci-fi movie universe.

evidence.quote: The ride is commonly seen as Shanghai Disneyland's replacement of [[Space Mountain]].
The ride allows riders to go on their own Lightcycle [[train]].
